NOT BUILDABLE, AND THIS IS RECORDED BEFORE THE ATTEMPT RATHER THAN AFTER IT.  `mx35_build.py` main() REFUSES --hidden-size composed with --ff in one build, on the stated grounds that a width fold has already re-solved every reader and writer against a new residual basis and a second selection would run inside tensors the first one replaced with neither axis's census having seen the other.  The guard was read in the source before this file was written and will be EXERCISED on the server so its exact text is on the record.  It is NOT routed around: wave 27's rule is that a refusal is recorded and not worked around, and the machinery that would compose two bodies sequentially does not exist in this estate.  The arithmetic is registered anyway so a later wave that builds the composition machinery has a number to check itself against: 168,410,240 for the body, 120,700,032 (0.525484x) for K=12,288 on it.

what_this_wave_will_NOT_claim: A canonical re-read is an ASSESSMENT of a sealed dossier and never becomes a sealed number.  Every child above is sealed on the frozen fifteen under the frozen protocol first, and read a second time under the canonical standard second, and the two counts are carried side by side everywhere.

THE DECODE-REPAIR GRID IN LANE D4 IS A RUNTIME DIAGNOSTIC.  It changes decode parameters and not a byte of any child, it is never sealed, it never appears in a ledger row, and no fold claim in this wave or any later one rests on it.  Wave 34 priced ONE penalty value; this wave prices four settings, and a grid of diagnostics is still a diagnostic.
The D3 arithmetic above is a REGISTERED NUMBER FOR A CHILD THAT WILL NOT EXIST.  No frontier row, no ledger row and no claim may cite it.

d4_decode_repair_grid_registered_in_adva.prediction: The mild penalties recover NOTHING and destroy LESS than 1.3 did -- the mechanism wave 34 measured is that a multiplicative penalty rescales every token the context has seen, including the ones a correct answer is made of, and 1.1 rescales them less hard.  The n-gram arm is the one that could genuinely differ, because it leaves a non-repeating token at exactly its sealed logit.  Registered prediction: 0-2 hand-confirmed recoveries across all four settings and all 75 lanes, and the n-gram arm losing FEWER than 13 of the 13 signal lanes.  If any setting recovers a real answer without killing the signal lanes, the artifact clause's remedy is cheaper than wave 34 priced it and this file says so in advance.
d4_decode_repair_grid_registered_in_adva.the_screen_never_makes_the_call: Wave 34R's rule, applied again: a keyed screen aims the reading and every flagged recovery is read at full length by hand before it is counted.  Wave 34's screen flagged seven and all seven were false positives.
